title: Werkzeug's MultiDict can retain all values of parameters with the same name
summary: Regular dictionary values usually return the first value of the key, and getlist returns all values with the same key.
applies: Flask default configuration; request and session data explanation
detail: For the input k=a&k=b, use get and getlist to log, and you may see a and a list with two elements respectively.
boundary: If the request had been converted to a normal dictionary at an earlier layer, duplicates might have been lost.
relevance: When reviewing the form and query log, avoid mistakenly thinking that the field with the same name has only been submitted once.
